ARI.hc_bio: Mike LaFleur is the head coach of the Arizona Cardinals in 2026, hired February 1, 2026 as the franchise's 45th head coach after three seasons (2023–2025) as Los Angeles Rams offensive coordinator. He played quarterback and safety at Elmhurst (2005–2008), then coached in college at Elmhurst, Saint Joseph's (IN), and Davidson before NFL stops as an intern with the Cleveland Browns (2014), offensive assistant with the Atlanta Falcons (2015–2016), passing-game coordinator with the San Francisco 49ers (2017–2020), and Jets offensive coordinator (2021–2022). He is the younger brother of Green Bay Packers head coach Matt LaFleur.

DET.hc_bio: Dan Campbell is the Detroit Lions' head coach in 2026, in his sixth season after being hired January 20, 2021. A former Texas A&M tight end drafted by the Giants in 1999 (third round), he played 11 NFL seasons and was Miami interim head coach in 2015. With Detroit he is 48–36–1 in the regular season, including a 15–2 NFC No. 1 seed in 2024; the Lions were 9–8 and missed the playoffs in 2025.

He played quarterback at Saginaw Valley State after two years at Western Michigan, then was Rams OC (2017), Titans OC (2018), and Packers HC with a 76–40–1 regular-season record through 2025 (nine playoff games, 3–6).
